eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
eviscerate.desc: Damage finisher; more damage per combo point.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.desc: Sneak around at reduced speed; swaps action bar 1 to the Stealth page. Can't be used in combat.

throw.name: Throw
throw.desc: Ranged attack with a thrown weapon (Shoot Bow/Gun/Crossbow if you equip one instead). Good for pulling.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Big dagger hit from behind, 1 combo point.

pickpocket.name: Pick Pocket
pickpocket.desc: Steal from a humanoid's pockets. Stealth only, doesn't break Stealth.

gouge.name: Gouge
gouge.desc: Incapacitates the target for 4 sec from the front; damage breaks it. 1 combo point.

sap.name: Sap
sap.desc: Incapacitates an out-of-combat humanoid for up to 25 sec from Stealth. Changed in Forever: no longer breaks Stealth (baseline).

sliceanddice.name: Slice and Dice
sliceanddice.desc: Finisher: +20% attack speed, longer per combo point.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.desc: +50% run speed for 15 sec. Doesn't break Stealth.

kick.name: Kick
kick.desc: Interrupts a spellcast and locks that school for 5 sec.

exposearmor.name: Expose Armor
exposearmor.desc: Finisher that lowers the target's armor for 30 sec. Changed in Forever: stronger, and no longer blocks Sunder Armor.

garrote.name: Garrote
garrote.desc: Bleed opener from Stealth, 1 combo point. Usable out of Stealth briefly after Ghostly Strike.

feint.name: Feint
feint.desc: Drops your threat. Changed in Forever: threat reduction doubled.

picklock.name: Pick Lock
picklock.desc: Opens locked chests and doors (needs Thieves' Tools). Learned at the trainer around 16.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Big dagger opener from Stealth, behind the target. 1 combo point. Usable out of Stealth briefly after Ghostly Strike.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.desc: Bleed finisher; lasts longer per combo point.

distract.name: Distract
distract.desc: Turns nearby enemies toward a spot. Changed in Forever: also lowers their Stealth detection for 10 sec. Doesn't break Stealth.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.desc: Drop combat and enter improved Stealth (bar 1 swaps to the Stealth page); breaks snares. Uses Flash Powder, 5 min cooldown.

shank.name: Shank
shank.desc: New in Forever: cheap off-hand stab that can't miss and restores Energy, 10 sec cooldown. Talents (Venom, Boot Knife, Flash of Steel) build on it. Rank 2 (1329549) at 44.

cheapshot.name: Cheap Shot
cheapshot.desc: Stun opener from Stealth, 4 sec, 2 combo points.

kidneyshot.name: Kidney Shot
kidneyshot.desc: Stun finisher; longer per combo point.

disarmtrap.name: Disarm Trap
disarmtrap.desc: Disarms a detected trap (needs Thieves' Tools).

blind.name: Blind
blind.desc: Disorients the target for up to 10 sec; damage breaks it. Uses Blinding Powder.

coldblood.name: Cold Blood
coldblood.desc: Next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate or Mutilate is a guaranteed crit.

mutilate.name: Mutilate
mutilate.desc: New in Forever: Assassination capstone. Hits with both weapons for 2 combo points, +20% vs poisoned targets. Rank 2 (1241584) at 60.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Strike usable after you parry; disarms the target for 6 sec.

bladeflurry.name: Blade Flurry
bladeflurry.desc: +20% attack speed and hits a second nearby enemy for 15 sec.

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.desc: Adds 2 combo points to the target, kept 20 sec. Changed in Forever: no longer needs Stealth, 20 sec window.

ghostlystrike.name: Ghostly Strike
ghostlystrike.desc: Strike that boosts dodge for 7 sec, 1 combo point. Changed in Forever: stronger with a dagger, and your next Ambush or Garrote within 7 sec doesn't need Stealth.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.desc: Combo builder; stronger with a dagger and makes the target take 15% more from your Rupture and Garrote (changed in Forever).

deathmark.name: Death Mark
deathmark.desc: New in Forever: Subtlety capstone finisher that stores part of your damage on the target and deals it after 6 sec. 10 sec cooldown.
